name: High School Fed Challenge
org: Federal Reserve Bank of New York (national), Chicago Fed (regional page)
what_you_do: A school team studies the economy and plays the part of the Fed's rate-setting committee. The 2026-27 theme is the economics of housing. Teams submit a paper, and top teams are chosen.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 9 to 12, entered as a team. A faculty advisor registers the team. Team size and entry limits are in the rule book, which the page links to.
pay_detail: No pay. No fee is listed.
duration: Registration Sept 10, 2026 to Feb 15, 2027. Paper due Mar 15, 2027.
deadline_text: Team registration closes Feb 15, 2027 at 11:59 pm ET. Paper due Mar 15, 2027. Notice to teams May 14, 2027.
how_to_apply: Ask a teacher to be your team advisor. The advisor signs up the team online. The advisor also emails a form from your principal to nyeconed@ny.frb.org. The page covers team entries only.
notes: The Chicago Fed page says teams register through the same national process and lists the same Feb 15, 2027 deadline. Good for a club, econ class or debate team.
